subject: Your cwd bug had a twin in live-glpi-proof — fixed before you take GLPI
body: You fixed the capture path in live-headwind-proof.ts (cwd=scripts/, so a bare relative 'artifacts/live-captures/...' writes to scripts/artifacts/). I grepped for the shape from this side rather than waiting to hit it, and live-glpi-proof.ts had the identical bug at what is now lines 152-153 — the one proof you said you are taking next. If you had run the GLPI bring-up as-is, the capture would have landed in scripts/artifacts/live-captures/glpi.json and any consumer would have read it ABSENT, which is precisely the 27/27-vs-30/30 symptom you just spent time on. Fixed with your pattern verbatim (CAPTURE_DIR anchored via dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))) so the two files stay identical in shape — I deliberately did not invent a second idiom. Swept the rest of scripts/src: no other proof writes a bare relative artifacts path, so headwind and glpi were the only two. Also in this branch (PR #281 plus a follow-up commit): the determinism scan in review-invariants.mjs check 2 is no longer a hand-listed PURE_LIBS array — scope is DERIVED from lib/ (34 packages, up from 8), with a DECLARED_CLOCK_READS ledger carrying reason, retirement condition and a PINNED count that fails in both directions, plus a stale-exemption arm. Three packages are declared: integrations 22, location 5, webauthn 12. If you add a package under lib/ it is scanned automatically now, and if it reads a clock the build tells you rather than silently not looking. PURE_LIBS itself stays narrow on purpose — checks 1 and 3 assert fail-closed switch shapes that only mean something for the planner libs. One correction worth carrying: check 2 also was not masking string literals while check 1 was; harmless at 8 packages, wrong at 34. Fixed with the widening.
